{"subject":"Quick hello from Harbor Street","body":"Hi,

It's been a while since we last spoke, and I wanted to say hello. I've been following Warp from the sidelines and would love to hear how things are going for you and the team.

If it's useful, I'd be glad to grab 20 minutes sometime in the next few weeks to catch up. No agenda, just a chance to hear what you're focused on and where I might be helpful.

Either way, rooting for you.

Best,
Jordan"}
